dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 compatible; likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler given LINE SEQUENTIAL organization and flat-file I/O to .TXT files. No mainframe-specific extensions.
evidence: ASSIGN to quoted filename strings like 'EMPFILE2.TXT'
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
READ ... INTO PAYROLL-RECORD with AT END / NOT AT END

purpose.domain_detail: Employee payroll processing: reads employee records, computes gross pay (with overtime), tax, health, and union deductions, then writes a payroll register report and summary file.
purpose.summary: Reads employee records from a flat file (EMPFILE2.TXT), computes gross pay including overtime at 1.5x, deducts 20% tax, 2% health, and $20 union dues for union members, then writes a formatted payroll register and a summary totals file.

notable_features: Union dues conditional on UNION-MEMBER flag
Two output files: payroll register and summary
No COMP-3 or packed decimal usage
No COPY statements or external subprogram calls
verdict.notes: Program authored by two named individuals (MEL SANSCHAGRIN, CHANDLER NEWMAN-REED), named PROJECT2PAYROLL suggesting a course project assignment. Logic is straightforward and complete but lacks error handling, production-grade features, or COMP-3 optimization. Max line length of 72 and fixed format confirmed.
